title: Private Equity Grabs easyJet, Wizz Air's Profit Collapses, and Korean Air Inherits a Superjumbo Problem
summary: Apollo just bought easyJet for £5.7 billion, and we get into what private equity buyouts usually do to airlines. Plus, Wizz Air's profit fell off a cliff while Ryanair barely flinched — same fuel crisis, wildly different outcomes — and Korean Air is about to have more A380s than it probably wants. Also, an update on Friday's ground stop that makes it look even worse, and Boeing has a rocket problem now too.
